events.title: Server Move (Again)
events.description: Omniscient secured a new server and datacenter for HF after the previous attempt was cut short when the old host shut down without notice, marking a major step toward full site upgrades.

events.title: Tether BTCPay Plugin
events.description: A Tether plugin went live on HF's BTCPay server as a trial, allowing invoices to be paid in USDT on TRC-20. Because addresses don't rotate automatically, its future isn't guaranteed.

events.title: Awards
events.description: King Decade awarded to Armagedon. Diamond awarded to bandors.

events.title: How Much Of Your Code Is AI Generated Now?
events.description: Mxstermind asked what share of members' code is AI-generated; several said nearly everything starts with AI while they focus on vision, troubleshooting, and final decisions.

events.title: Project Rescue - Repair and Complete Your Broken AI-Generated Project
events.description: Tha Sneak offered a free service to triage, repair, validate, and document broken vibe-coded projects instead of starting over.

events.title: UnityScraper - AI-Written XboxUnity Asset Scraper
events.description: Null State released UnityScraper, an XboxUnity asset scraping and extraction framework built almost entirely through prompting, later expanded with ChatGPT and Codex to add Linux support.

events.title: My cat wants say hey to HackForums!!!
events.description: geoshot introduced his cats to HF, and the thread filled with compliments, requests for more pictures, and members' own cat stories.

events.title: Does anyone else feel like 90% of the internet is just bots talking to bots now?
events.description: M1MON asked whether the internet is turning into bots talking to bots, sparking discussion of AI content, ragebait, political manipulation, and the Dead Internet Theory.

events.title: [$100] Crypto Giveaway
events.description: Froggerini is giving away $100 in crypto; ends August 16, 2026.
